summary: Gold Fields filed a Form 6-K furnishing its SENS announcement of Q3 2026 operational results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Attributable gold-equivalent production was 605koz at AISC of US$1,965/oz and AIC of US$2,266/oz. Salares Norte produced 136koz at US$437/oz AISC. Windfall received its Certificate of Authorisation, permitting construction. Additional buybacks of US$554 million were completed by 3 November 2026, taking total repurchases under the Additional Shareholder Returns Programme to US$854 million. Net debt to adjusted EBITDA was 0.13x. This is a routine operations update, not a special situation.
